text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64,690 while Ethereum has dipped slightly, suggesting traders are risk-averse and rotating toward larger-cap assets given the Extreme Fear sentiment reading. BTC dominance at 58.4% and muted volume of $77B indicate a cautious market lacking conviction, though Solana's modest outperformance hints at selective interest in alternative narratives. The 7-day fear deterioration points to sustained pessimism rather than panic capitulation.
